sections.Profile:
The Ali Baba pinball machine, produced by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1973, is an electro-mechanical, two-player game with a fantasy theme based on the legendary tale of Ali Baba.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1973–1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Myth and Legend, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy
